text:
incident-bot: Paging oncall @sanjay — SLO alert: inference.streaming p99 = 2.1s (target 0.75s), p95 = 650ms. Increased tail latencies and streaming stalls reported. Alert: alert-ig-9876.

sanjay: I'm on it. seeing a spike starting ~2234567800. Streaming tail errors up ~4.8% (client reported stalls / long hung connections). digging logs now.

maria: FYI support getting 3 customer tickets about partial responses and timeouts for chat streaming. customers affected across us-west regions.

ashwin: quick telemetry — control-plane config fetch p99 spiked to 850ms, auth token fetch p99 ~600ms. DB read latency for config_store read-heavy table spike ~120ms -> 900ms on some replicas. Could be replica lag / connection pool exhaustion.

leo: Repro run: locally replayed request pattern and saw prefix KV cache miss rate jumped from 2% -> 37% during spike. That would amplify control-plane reads.

ops-bot: Deploys: No recent infra deploys in last 30m. Autoscaling events: none.

incident-bot: Severity: Sev2 (customer impact, partial outages). Paging policy: escalate if not mitigated in 20m.

sanjay: Immediate mitigation plan: 1) Increase config cache TTL on edge to 60s (was 5s) to reduce control-plane reads. 2) Route streaming to fallback model instance pool (lower memory, same API) to reduce pressure on heavy model pods. 3) Throttle non-interactive background eval traffic via rate limit rule. 4) Add circuit-breaker on config_store reads for customers above threshold. Doing 1 & 3 now.

maria: I'll open a status note and notify CS about temporary mitigation + ETA. Support-bot, please add affected customers list from tickets.

support-bot: Affected customers: AcmePayments (partial streaming), NoteWave (timeouts), two small PLG apps. Severity flags added to their tickets.

ashwin: Rolling config change for edge cache TTL now: patching envoy config on 6 edge nodes. Command: 
```
kubectl -n infra set env deploy/edge-proxy CACHE_TTL=60
```
Applying to 6/6 now.

leo: I'm switching routing for 15% of traffic to fallback model pool (canary) to see effect, command below.
```
redwoodctl routing set inference.streaming --traffic-split main:85,fallback-small:15 --reason "mitigation: reduce tail" 
```

sanjay: Also bumping config_store connection pool size on app controlplane from 50 -> 120 to reduce errors. Doing a short restart of two pods (staggered).

ops-bot: edge cache env updated on 6/6 — observed immediate drop in config_store reads by ~48%.

ashwin: After routing change p95 dropped from 650ms -> 420ms and p99 from 2.1s -> 1.05s in last 60s window. Streaming stalls decreased in telemetry.

maria: Nice. CS notified customers with temporary mitigation message. They asked for ETA to full resolution.

sanjay: Next steps to full resolution: 1) verify DB replica health and catch-up (possible hot replica with slow disk). 2) rehearse reducing feature flag check frequency (we do frequent per-request check now). 3) add optimistic local feature flag cache for 10s TTL. ashwin/leo can you take 1 & 2? I'll coordinate rollout and then handoff if needed.

leo: On replica health — DB team alerted. I see one replica with high iowait and increased replication lag (~4s). Opening ticket to ops-db. Pushing read traffic away from that replica.

ashwin: I'll toggle feature-flag local cache param to 10s for streaming route. Patch is small, running canary.

ops-bot: DB ops acknowledged: elevated iowait on config_store-replica-3, scheduling maintenance slf-check. Re-routing reads away from replica-3 applied.

maria: Metrics look stable after reroute and cache changes. p99 trending down ~900ms -> 700ms; errors down to 1.1%. Sustaining for 6m.

sanjay: Good. I'll keep incident open for observation window 30m. If stable, we'll de-escalate to Sev3. If it resurges, escalate DB ops for urgent hardware replacement.

tara: Noted for postmortem: capture sequence: high config fetch miss rate -> DB replica iowait -> increased control-plane latency -> streaming tail SLO breach. Also list caching and routing mitigations and why they helped.

maria: Creating incident doc and initial timeline. Adding action items: add heartbeat to replica monitoring, increase default edge cache TTL to 10s for streaming routes, improve circuit-breaker backoffs, run load test for config_store at current QPS.

support-bot: CS updated tickets with mitigation steps and asked customers for any remaining impact. No new high-severity reports in last 10m.

sanjay: Handing off watch to @leo for night shift at 2234567925. If any regression, page me directly and escalate to DB on-call.

leo: Acking. I'll monitor p95/p99 and replica lag. Adding runbook note.

maria: Thanks team. Closing active customer-facing alerts if no regressions after observation window. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Will auto-close if stable for 30m."
